# #3636: `.execute(...)` / `.executemany(...)` call sites per file under src/tradepartner/
# outside store/, counted by tests/test_sql_boundary.py. One line per file: <count> <path>,
# the path relative to src/tradepartner/. The numbers only go down: a new query goes in a
# function under src/tradepartner/store/. To lower a line after removing a site (or to move
# sites between files without raising the total), run `uv run python tests/test_sql_boundary.py`
# and commit the result in the same PR.
